articles.title: Denise Bruckner, 74, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Denise Bruckner for the many years of service to Eastgate.
body: Denise Bruckner died in September at home on Quarry Court, at the age of 74. Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Denise Bruckner spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Stonebridge Trail Crew in his or her name. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate.

articles.title: Letter: Scout Troop 14 Did a Good Job This Summer
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the crosswalk in the budget. Many of us on Keystone Lane use it every week.
To the editor: I have lived on Keystone Lane for 13 years, and I want to say what a difference Scout Troop 14 has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the December meeting.
Felix Wojcik, Stonebridge
